People and offices
The Dubai office moved to a larger floor in
Business Bay in September. The Cairo office
opened a second training room, which hosts
the monthly engineering guild and the
new-joiner programme.
Fourteen engineers completed the internal
cloud migration certification this quarter. The
programme covers rollback planning, cost
tagging and the runbook format that every
migration now follows.
What comes next
In the next quarter the integration team will
publish a reference architecture for
connecting legacy accounting systems without
replacing them. Drafts will be reviewed by two
client engineering leads before release.
Questions about these notes can be sent to
the internal communications team. External
enquiries should use hello@niletech.example.
NileTech Field Notes — Autumn 2026
Synthetic benchmark fixture. Not a NileTech publication.
Delivery in Alexandria
The Alexandria delivery team completed the
warehouse integration for a regional
distributor in eleven weeks. The project
replaced three spreadsheets and a nightly
email with a governed workflow that posts
stock movements to the distributor's ledger
within minutes.
The team kept the old process running in
parallel for two full month-end closes. Only
after both closes reconciled to the cent did the
distributor switch off the spreadsheets.
Data platform milestones
Our data platform practice now runs a shared
analytics layer for four clients. Each client
keeps its own warehouse schema, and every
dashboard reads from views that carry the
client's access rules.
Query volume tripled between July and
September. Median dashboard load time
stayed under two seconds because the
heaviest reports are precomputed overnight
